sn48.58:1.1: evaṃ me sutaṃ. ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate sūkarakhatāyaṃ.
sn48.58:1.2: tatra kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi:
sn48.58:1.3: “kinnu kho sāriputta, atthavasaṃ sampassamāno khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṃ pavattamāno pavattatī”ti?
sn48.58:1.4: anuttaraṃ hi bhante, yogakkhemaṃ sampassamāno khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṃ pavattamāno pavattatīti.
sn48.58:1.6: anuttaraṃ hi sāriputta, yogakkhemaṃ sampassamāno khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṃ pavattamāno pavattati.
sn48.58:2.1: katamo ca sāriputta, anuttaro yogakkhemo, yaṃ sampassamāno khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṃ pavattamāno pavattatīti.
sn48.58:2.2: idha bhante, khīṇāsavo bhikkhu saddhindriyaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ,
sn48.58:2.7: ayaṃ kho bhante, anuttaro yogakkhemo yaṃ sampassamāno khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṃ pavattamāno pavattatīti.
sn48.58:2.9: eso hi sāriputta, anuttaro yogakkhemo yaṃ sampassamāno khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṃ pavattamāno pavattati.
sn48.58:3.1: katamo ca sāriputta, paramanipaccakāro yaṃ khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṃ pavattamāno pavattatīti.
sn48.58:3.2: idha bhante, khīṇāsavo bhikkhu satthari sagāravo viharati sappatisso. dhamme sagāravo viharati sappatisso. saṅghe sagāravo viharati sappatisso. sikkhāya sagāravo viharati sappatisso. samādhismiṃ sagāravo viharati sappatisso.
sn48.58:3.3: ayaṃ kho bhante, paramanipaccakāro yaṃ khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṃ pavattamāno pavattatīti.
sn48.58:3.5: eso hi sāriputta, paramanipaccakāro yaṃ khīṇāsavo bhikkhu tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccakāraṃ pavattayamāno pavattatīti.
